google.name: Google style and docs guides
google.description: Google's engineering style guides (19 languages plus Markdown docs), the Swift guide, the code review guide (eng-practices) and the OpenDocs documentation planning guides and templates.

paths.when: finding which Google style guide applies
writing Go: style guide, decisions, best practices
configuring pylint for the Python guide
configuring Eclipse CDT for the C++ guide
configuring Emacs c-style for the C++ guide
configuring Vim indentation for the Python guide
code review: overview of Google's practices
reviewing a PR or CL: standard, what to look for, speed, comments, pushback
authoring a PR or CL: description, small changes, replying to review comments
planning a documentation set or choosing document types
writing service docs or runbooks: overview
writing service docs or runbooks: templates (build, operations, security, disaster recovery, common tasks)
shaping a documentation project (archetypes: audit, edit, factory, manual, migration, prototype, study, translation)

Enforcers: C++: cppguide → clang-format with BasedOnStyle: Google; cpplint lives in cpplint/cpplint
Outside the org (link, do not quote): Developer documentation style guide: https://developers.google.com/style (no public source)
Angular style guide: https://angular.dev (angular/angular); Effective Dart: https://dart.dev (dart-lang/site-www)
Docsy, the docs theme, moved to docsy/docsy
Skipped: season-of-docs: program management (budget, hiring, mentoring), not writing style
gts, eslint-config-google, eslint-closure, closure-linter: tooling; the rules they enforce are in styleguide
google-java-format, yapf, pyink, vim-codefmt, keep-sorted, yamlfmt, json5format, rfmt: formatters (see Enforcers)
GOS-conventions, pulito: tiny, archived, niche layout conventions
gerrit-linter, git-presubmit-linter, lintush, arc-proselint, arc-regex-line-length-linter: archived lint scripts
aside, skills_lint.dart: tooling with no style text; gsocguides, oss-vulnerability-guide, comprehensive-rust: guides, not style
styleguide: _includes/, _sass/, assets/, include/, 404.html, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md; opendocs: sponsorship/, project_archetypes/images/ (13 MB), templates/README.md (empty)

facebook.name: Facebook (Meta) style and docs guides
facebook.description: Meta engineering conventions from github.com/facebook project repositories: C++, C, Rust and Thrift coding guidelines, design-system and CLI conventions, and docs-writing guides (flipper, folly, buck2, astryx, docusaurus).

paths.when: writing C++ in a folly-style library: coding and documentation style
writing prose, contributor notes and commit summaries (folly's writing rule package)
folly writing rules: author and review checklists for prose and commit summaries
writing C++ in HHVM style: language features, formatting, comments
writing C in bpfilter style (clang-format enforced)
writing Rust in buck2: coding conventions, error message style
contributing to buck2: formatting, coding style
writing comments, API docs, READMEs and LLM context files
structuring code as a tree so humans can review it (Docusaurus agent skill)
writing documentation, linting and formatting in Docusaurus (agent instructions)
writing FBOSS code: standards and patterns (agent skill)
FBOSS patterns: agent, contributing, general, platform config, SAI SDK, testing, Thrift/COW/FSDB
writing developer documentation: why, style, structure (archived repo, frozen)

Enforcers: sapling: rustfmt.toml, eden/scm/.rustfmt.toml, eden/scm/.flake8, addons/prettier.config.cjs, website/.eslintrc.js
Outside the org: Sibling orgs not surveyed: facebookincubator, facebookresearch, facebookexperimental, facebookarchive
Moved out: react, react-native, create-react-app, metro and yoga now live in the react org; jest is jestjs/jest
Meta's Python formatter stack: usort is here, ufmt (Black plus µsort) is omnilib/ufmt
Meta-internal only: the C++ wiki pages that sapling's CodingCpp.md defers to, and folly/agents/README.md's internal install path
Skipped: No dedicated style-guide repository exists; guides live inside project repositories, mostly one file each
litho docs/legacy-spec-api/coding-style.md: deprecated Java Spec API; pyrefly tensor-shapes style_guide.md: niche tensor-shape annotation style

Agent instruction files with a style section (hermes, rocksdb, igl, infer, bpfilter CLAUDE.md; infer, meta-wearables-dat-android, meta-wearables-dat-ios, capi-param-builder AGENTS.md): needs section slicing, not built
fbjs eslint-config-fbjs, eslint-config-fb-strict, eslint-config-fbjs-opensource (2022) and the usort README: rules and tools, not prose
Forks carrying their upstream project's guide: fbnic_qemu (QEMU), fbghc (GHC), openbmc-linux (Linux kernel), kuduraft (Apache Kudu), gfxreconstruct (LunarG)

About 25 boilerplate CONTRIBUTING.md 'Coding Style: 2 spaces, 80 columns' sections; about 70 repositories with formatter configuration only; static analyzers (infer, pyre-check, pyrefly, Pysa, Lifeguard, mariana-trench)
stylex (a CSS styling system); flipper/docs/extending/style-guide.mdx (UI design, rendered from a React component)
